assumptions.claim: initialized is false on entry for a newly deployed ERC-1167 clone and true on the shared Raffle implementation contract, and all other clone storage slots start at zero/false.

params.prizeToken contains deployed bytecode, is not a protocol destination (factory, quoteToken, vrfWrapper, raffleImplementation, or an existing registered raffle), and reports ERC-165 support for IERC721.
assumptions.establishedBy: RaffleFactory.createRaffle -> RaffleFactory._validateCreateParams (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L98, L154-L177, L183-L185) and Clones.clone ordering (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L106)

assumptions.claim: params.prizeToken is a standards-compliant, non-malicious ERC-721 contract whose transferFrom and ownerOf behave according to EIP-721 at future redemption or release time.
params.prizeTokenId is owned by or approved for params.sponsor and is escrowed into the clone immediately after initialization so the clone transitions from Status.AwaitingPrize to Status.Active.
params.reserveEntries is strictly greater than zero so Status.CashWon remains reachable when totalEntries < reserveEntries.
params.endTime is strictly greater than block.timestamp and at most block.timestamp + RaffleConstants.MAX_SALE_DURATION (30 days).
params.raffleId is a unique, sequential, one-based identifier consistent with RaffleFactory.raffleById and RaffleFactory.idByRaffle.

Neither params.sponsorRecipient nor params.protocolTreasury is an undeployed address (code.length == 0 at initialization time) that will later be deployed and registered as a Raffle clone in RaffleFactory.isRaffle before quote-token claims are released via _transferQuote.

calls.propagates: Returns true if destination equals address(this), factory, address(quoteToken), address(i_vrfV2PlusWrapper), prizeToken_, or canonicalFactory.raffleImplementation() (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L599-L601), or if destination.code.length != 0 and canonicalFactory.isRaffle(destination) is true (L602-L604). Does not query canonicalFactory.isRaffle when destination.code.length == 0 (L602), and catches destination == address(this) at L599 even though RaffleFactory.createRaffle has not yet set isRaffle[address(this)] = true at L125.

Returns the immutable raffleImplementation address configured in RaffleFactory.constructor (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L42, L91) when queried by _isProtocolDestination (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L601).

Returns true only for clone addresses already registered in RaffleFactory.createRaffle at packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L125 (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L54, called from packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L603 when destination.code.length != 0); returns false for the currently initializing clone and any future undeployed clone addresses.

invariants.claim: initialize can succeed at most once per clone and only when called by the immutable factory address; it can never succeed on the shared implementation contract.
Upon completion of initialize, sponsor, sponsorRecipient, protocolTreasury, and address(prizeToken) are all non-zero addresses.

Upon completion of initialize, none of sponsor, protocolTreasury, or sponsorRecipient equals address(this), factory, address(quoteToken), address(i_vrfV2PlusWrapper), address(prizeToken), IRaffleFactory(factory).raffleImplementation(), or any contract address where IRaffleFactory(factory).isRaffle(addr) was true at initialization time.

Upon completion of initialize, sponsor, sponsorRecipient, protocolTreasury, prizeToken, prizeTokenId, raffleId, reserveEntries, and endTime are set to the factory-supplied params and have no other writers in Raffle.sol, and status is Status.AwaitingPrize.
